lines.t: A-U-B
A-U-B
Salvation will not depart from you
Once you truly receive this gift so true
Seek to please the Father, keep the law
For how can grace walk with what once condemned you to?
Can hands reach heaven? Why your feet tread the wide and broken way?
How can love hold both the grave and the good ground?
Each new day knowledge must increase in my scenes
To find that kingdom's gain under grace
Bear its fruit, let his works illuminate
Beloved sons, I am in the Father
He is in me, together as one
And if I am in you, do as I have done
Embrace the cross, don't fear its weight
Become the example for which you are called
Can hands reach heaven while your feet
Tread the wide and broken way
How can love hold both the grave
And the good ground each new day
Knowledge must increase and must cease
To find that kingdom's gate under grace
There its fruit, let his works illuminate
Grace comes first and is everlasting
Then follow the works
Faith's first offering, firstfruits rise from hearts made new
To love the Father, to love each other too
Can hands reach heaven? Why your feet tread the wide and broken way?
How can love hold both the grave and the good ground each new day?
Knowledge must increase, sin must cease
To find that kingdom's gate under grace
There its fruit, let its works illuminate
So love the Father, love one another
By keeping the law together forever
Grace revealed through every deed
The kingdom's door for all who believe
Thank you.
